description: Bounding envelope fallback risked including non-AOI ocean/land pixels
remediation_action: Eliminated bounding envelope from processing masks; analysis strictly bound to Master AOI geometry

description: Confusion between 17280 candidate cells and 8129 canonical cells
remediation_action: Enforced 8129 canonical cells baseline; clarified 17280 is candidate pre-clipping bbox matrix only

description: Computing wind stress from monthly mean wind underestimates non-linear stress
remediation_action: Implemented instantaneous 6-hour wind stress per CFSv2 frame using Wu (1982) prior to monthly reduction

description: Ekman pumping equation sign and beta term handling
remediation_action: Implemented exact oceanographic curl and beta formulation with f < 0 and safe equatorial margin handling

description: UT-06/07 velocity conversion documented erroneously as 1.68 m/day
remediation_action: Corrected conversion formula to 1.755e-5 m/s = 1.51632 m/day (1.52 m/day rounded)

description: Thermal front Sobel gradient computed without metric longitude convergence
remediation_action: Applied latitude-dependent longitudinal convergence scaling in km to produce physical degC/km units

description: ETOPO1 bedrock elevation vs positive ocean depth ambiguity
remediation_action: Assigned bedrock as elevation_m (negative in sea); derived depth_m = -elevation_m; masked land

description: Chlorophyll-a lack of dynamic sensor fallback and GCOM-C scale factor ambiguity
remediation_action: Implemented dynamic sensor selection (MODIS primary; GCOM-C secondary with verified scale factor 0.0016)

description: Un-ingested CMEMS months lacked explicit missing asset governance
remediation_action: Implemented strict null masking with flag SENSOR_FALLBACK_MISSING_ASSET for un-ingested months

description: Absence of strict mode boundaries and accidental full-run prevention
remediation_action: Hardcoded DEVELOPMENT mode and safety gates (ENABLE_FULL_BATCH=false
